paragraphs.context: Queen: Since the death of Queen Oasis, the tribe is split between
paragraphs.mainIdea: Three sisters want to be queen.
paragraphs.simple: Queen Oasis of the SandWings died. Now her three daughters, Burn, Blister and Blaze, all want her throne.

background.note: Queen Oasis was the SandWing queen before the war. After she died, her three daughters fought over her throne.
Burn is one of three SandWing sisters who are fighting to be queen. She is huge and violent.
Blister is one of three SandWing sisters who are fighting to be queen. She is clever and cold.
Blaze is one of three SandWing sisters who are fighting to be queen. She is friendly but not very clever.

paragraphs.context: Alliances: Burn fights alongside SkyWings and MudWings; Blister is allied with the
paragraphs.simple: Each SandWing sister has friends in other tribes. Burn has the SkyWings and MudWings, Blister has the SeaWings, and Blaze has the IceWings.

background.note: The desert dragons of Pyrrhia. They have pale gold scales and a poisonous barb on the end of the tail, and they can live a long time without water.
Silver-white or pale blue dragons from the frozen north of Pyrrhia. They can live in great cold and breathe out a deadly freezing breath (frostbreath).

paragraphs.context: Abilities: can breathe fire (if warm enough), hold their breath for up
paragraphs.simple: MudWings can breathe fire when they are warm, stay under water or mud for an hour without breathing, and hide in mud. They are very strong.

paragraphs.context: Abilities: powerful fighters and fliers, can breathe fire
paragraphs.simple: SkyWings are strong fighters and fast fliers, and they can breathe fire.

paragraphs.context: Description: blue or green or aquamarine scales; webs between their claws; gills
paragraphs.simple: SeaWings are blue or green. They have skin between their claws, gills for breathing under water, and stripes that glow in the dark.

paragraphs.context: Abilities: can withstand subzero temperatures and bright light, exhale a deadly freezing breath
paragraphs.simple: IceWings can live in very cold places and bright light, and they breathe out a deadly freezing breath.

paragraphs.context: Abilities: can camouflage their scales to blend into their surroundings, use their
paragraphs.simple: RainWings can change the colors of their scales to hide and can hold on to branches with their tails. The guide says they have no natural weapons.

paragraphs.context: Abilities: can breathe fire, disappear into dark shadows, read minds, foretell the future
paragraphs.simple: NightWings breathe fire and hide in shadows. The guide says they can read minds and see the future.

background.note: The power to hear what other dragons are thinking. The guide says NightWings have this power.

paragraphs.context: Queen: a closely guarded secret
paragraphs.mainIdea: The NightWing queen is a secret.
paragraphs.simple: Nobody outside the tribe knows who the NightWing queen is.

paragraphs.context: When the war has lasted twenty years …
paragraphs.simple: This is the Dragonet Prophecy. Its first lines say that the dragonets will come when the war has gone on for twenty years.

background.note: The old prophecy that says five dragonets hatched on the brightest night will end the war.

paragraphs.context: When the land is soaked in blood and tears …
paragraphs.mainIdea: A land full of blood and tears.
paragraphs.simple: The dragonets will also come when the land is full of blood and tears: when many dragons have died and many are sad.

paragraphs.context: Find the SeaWing egg of deepest blue.
paragraphs.simple: These lines tell which eggs to find. One is a dark blue SeaWing egg. "Wings of night" means that a NightWing dragonet will come too.

paragraphs.context: The largest egg in mountain high
paragraphs.simple: The biggest egg, from high in the mountains, will give a SkyWing ("wings of sky").

paragraphs.context: For wings of earth, search through the mud
paragraphs.simple: For a MudWing ("wings of earth"), look in the mud for a red egg, the color of dragon blood.

paragraphs.context: And hidden alone from the rival queens,
paragraphs.simple: A SandWing egg is waiting, hidden where the SandWing queens who fight each other cannot find it.

paragraphs.context: Of three queens who blister and blaze and burn,
paragraphs.simple: Three SandWing sisters want to be queen. Two of them will die. "Blister and blaze and burn" are words for burning, and also the names of the sisters.

background.note: Blister is one of three SandWing sisters who are fighting to be queen. She is clever and cold.
Blaze is one of three SandWing sisters who are fighting to be queen. She is friendly but not very clever.
Burn is one of three SandWing sisters who are fighting to be queen. She is huge and violent.

paragraphs.context: if she bows to a fate that is stronger and higher,
paragraphs.simple: The sister who lives will learn this: if she accepts a fate that is stronger and higher than her, she will have great power, the "wings of fire".

paragraphs.context: Five eggs to hatch on brightest night,
paragraphs.mainIdea: Five eggs on the brightest night.
paragraphs.simple: Five eggs will hatch on the brightest night, and the five dragons will be born to end the war.

background.note: A night when all three moons are full at the same time. The prophecy says the five dragonets will hatch on the brightest night.

paragraphs.context: At least, that’s what Queen Oasis kept telling herself as she hurried
paragraphs.simple: It is almost impossible to steal from a royal dragon. That is what Queen Oasis tells herself as she hurries through her dark palace.

background.note: Queen Oasis was the SandWing queen before the war. After she died, her three daughters fought over her throne.

paragraphs.context: Something was wrong. There was something scrabbling around in her palace. With
paragraphs.simple: Oasis hears something moving around in her palace. Her hearing is very good, and she hears squeaking and maybe coins.

paragraphs.context: So what was it? Was she imagining it? She’d woken from a
paragraphs.simple: She woke up suddenly, as if someone had stabbed her. She decides to check on her treasure anyway.

paragraphs.context: The SandWing queen whirled around a corner and collided with two of
paragraphs.simple: Oasis turns a corner and crashes into two of her daughters, Blaze and Blister.

background.note: Blaze is one of three SandWing sisters who are fighting to be queen. She is friendly but not very clever.
Blister is one of three SandWing sisters who are fighting to be queen. She is clever and cold.

paragraphs.context: Blister said nothing, but sidestepped into a corner to get out of
paragraphs.simple: Blister watches her mother all the time. Oasis has always felt that Blister will kill her one day. Burn is bigger and stronger, but Oasis and Burn get along.

background.note: Burn is one of three SandWing sisters who are fighting to be queen. She is huge and violent.

paragraphs.context: Blister, on the other talon, always seemed to be calculating the moments
paragraphs.simple: Blister always seems to be counting the moments until her mother dies, because then Blister would be queen.

paragraphs.context: “What’s the hurry?” Blister asked smoothly, as if she couldn’t sense the
paragraphs.simple: Blister calmly asks why her mother is in a hurry, as if she cannot feel her mother's hate. She jokes that Smolder ran off with his girlfriend again.

background.note: Smolder is a SandWing, Burn's brother.

paragraphs.context: Dizzy Blaze, Oasis thought as she hurried on. She’d be a terrible
paragraphs.simple: Oasis thinks Blaze is silly and would be a bad queen, but she is an OK daughter, because she is not dangerous.

paragraphs.context: Oasis hesitated, but she knew if she said no, Blister would find
paragraphs.simple: Oasis lets Blister come, because it is better to keep her where she can see her. Oasis knows Blister wants the treasure, but she cannot have it while Oasis lives.

paragraphs.context: “I wouldn’t know what those smell like,” Blister said, wrinkling her nose.
paragraphs.simple: Blister says she does not know how scavengers smell. She does not like them: they are too big and soft for her.

paragraphs.context: Queen Oasis selected the right keys from around her neck and unlocked
paragraphs.simple: Oasis unlocks the doors and quickly looks through each treasure room.

paragraphs.context: “Scavengers,” spat the queen. “Robbed me. How dare they?” She lashed her
paragraphs.simple: Scavengers have robbed her! Oasis is very angry. She tells Blister to wake Burn and meet her outside.

background.note: Dragons call humans 'scavengers'. In these books scavengers are small, clever people whom dragons often see as pests or pets.

paragraphs.context: “Small things, for the most part,” Oasis growled. “But they also took
paragraphs.simple: The thieves took mostly small things, but they also took the Eye of Onyx.

background.note: A famous SandWing treasure. The SandWing who holds it can rule the kingdom.

paragraphs.context: “We’ll get it back,” Oasis promised. “And we’ll have roasted scavenger for
paragraphs.simple: Oasis promises to get the treasure back and eat the scavengers for breakfast. She hurries toward the nearest way out to the sky.

paragraphs.context: As Oasis charged into the courtyard, spread her wings, and lifted into
paragraphs.simple: Oasis flies off. She sees Blister look back at the open treasure rooms, but she thinks Blister is too clever to steal anything.

paragraphs.context: She wheeled toward the outer walls, scanning the sands. A disturbing thought
paragraphs.simple: Oasis turns in the air and looks at the sand. She worries: what if Blister does not wake Burn, and Oasis must face the thieves alone?

paragraphs.context: She narrowed her eyes, advancing up the dunes toward the sound of
paragraphs.simple: Oasis narrows her eyes and moves up the sand hills toward the squeaking sound.

paragraphs.context: After all … what’s the worst that could happen?
paragraphs.simple: Oasis thinks nothing bad can happen to her. But readers of the prophecy know that Queen Oasis died, and her death started the war.

background.note: Queen Oasis was the SandWing queen before the war. After she died, her three daughters fought over her throne.

paragraphs.context: She was going to save the world.
paragraphs.simple: Sunny always believed that she and her four friends would stop the war and bring peace to all dragons, because the prophecy said so.

background.note: The large land (continent) where all the dragon tribes in these books live.
A message that tells what will happen in the future. NightWings who can see the future give prophecies.

paragraphs.context: Besides, it explained everything. Why else was she so small and weird
paragraphs.simple: Sunny does not look like other SandWings: her scales and eyes are a strange colour and her tail has no poison barb. She thought this was because she was special.

background.note: The desert dragons of Pyrrhia. They have pale gold scales and a poisonous barb on the end of the tail, and they can live a long time without water.

paragraphs.context: Then there were her parents, the mysterious dragons who had left her
paragraphs.simple: Nobody knows who Sunny's parents are. Her egg was left alone in the desert. Sunny told herself this was part of the prophecy too.

paragraphs.context: And her destiny was important. There was nothing more important than stopping
paragraphs.simple: For Sunny, nothing was more important than ending the war. She often dreamed about the families who would be happy again.

paragraphs.context: And it was a lie.
paragraphs.simple: Now Sunny has learned that the prophecy was not real.

paragraphs.context: Rock walls scraped against her wings as she scrambled away from the NightWing island.
paragraphs.simple: Sunny runs through the tunnel away from the NightWing island and the volcano. She leaves her friends behind with Morrowseer.

background.note: The NightWings' secret home: an island with a volcano. A magic tunnel joins it to the rainforest.
Morrowseer is a big, scary NightWing. Years ago he told the Talons of Peace about the Dragonet Prophecy.

paragraphs.context: He made up the prophecy. It was all a trick.
paragraphs.simple: Morrowseer said he made up the prophecy as a trick.

paragraphs.context: She burst out of the tunnel into the rainforest and immediately slammed
paragraphs.simple: Sunny comes out into the rainforest and crashes into a crowd of NightWings.

background.note: The thick, hot, wet forest in Pyrrhia where the RainWings live. The books call the RainWings' home 'the rainforest'.
Purple-black dragons with silver scales under their wings, like a night sky full of stars. Many dragons believe they can read minds and see the future.

paragraphs.context: In the moonlight, the entire rainforest seemed to be seething with dragons.
paragraphs.simple: It is night and raining. The rainforest is full of noisy NightWings and RainWings, and it is hard to see who is who.

paragraphs.context: “Everyone calm down!” Glory’s voice shouted.
paragraphs.simple: Glory, the new RainWing queen, tells everyone to calm down.

background.note: Glory is a RainWing, one of the five dragonets of the prophecy. She can change the colour of her scales and shoot venom.

paragraphs.context: “Listen!” bellowed Grandeur, the old royal RainWing. “Your new queen is speaking!”
paragraphs.simple: Grandeur, an old RainWing, tells the NightWings to listen to their new queen, Glory.

background.note: Grandeur is one of the RainWing queens who take turns ruling.

paragraphs.context: Sunny ducked and wriggled through the crowd, but she couldn’t get any
paragraphs.simple: Some RainWings are guarding the stream with NightWing spears, but they do not know how to hold them.

background.note: Dragons of the rainforest whose scales change colour. They can hide by matching the colours around them, and they can shoot venom from their fangs.

paragraphs.context: What she really wanted to do was crash away into the rainforest
paragraphs.simple: Sunny wants to run away. She feels that her friends do not care about the prophecy at all.

paragraphs.context: Tsunami wants to believe Morrowseer. She’s never wanted to fulfill the prophecy
paragraphs.simple: Sunny thinks Tsunami is happy to believe that the prophecy is false.

background.note: Tsunami is a SeaWing princess, one of the five dragonets of the prophecy. She is brave and likes to be the leader.

paragraphs.context: Clay would be just as happy if nobody ever noticed how wonderful he is.
paragraphs.simple: Clay never wanted to be a hero. He only wants to look after his friends.

background.note: Clay is a MudWing, one of the five dragonets of the prophecy. He is big, kind and loyal.

paragraphs.context: Starflight would love to stop worrying about the prophecy.
paragraphs.simple: Starflight always worried about the prophecy, so he will be glad to stop.

background.note: Starflight is a NightWing, one of the five dragonets of the prophecy. He is shy and very clever, and he loves reading scrolls.

paragraphs.context: None of them will fight for our destiny.
paragraphs.simple: Sunny thinks her friends will not listen to her. They always treat her as a sweet little dragon with silly dreams.

paragraphs.context: She gazed up at the mass of dark trees overhead, where the
paragraphs.mainIdea: She cannot even run away well.
paragraphs.simple: Sunny thinks that even if she ran away, she would get stuck and her friends would have to rescue her.

paragraphs.context: It wouldn’t be like this in the desert, she thought.
paragraphs.simple: Sunny looks at the other tunnel, which goes to the desert. She wishes she could fly there and stop thinking.

background.note: The desert land of the SandWings.

paragraphs.context: Morrowseer’s spiteful words kept going around and around in her head.
paragraphs.simple: Sunny keeps remembering what Morrowseer said: the war will go on for years, and everyone will think the dragonets failed.

paragraphs.context: Glory climbed onto a boulder and flapped her wings loudly.
paragraphs.simple: Glory stands on a rock to speak. She looks small next to the big NightWings.

paragraphs.context: “NightWings,” Glory said firmly, speaking up to be heard over the shuffling
paragraphs.simple: Glory tells the NightWings that their old home and queen are gone. If they want to live here, they must treat the RainWings with respect.

paragraphs.context: “Tonight you’ll stay right here,” Glory went on.
paragraphs.simple: Glory says the NightWings must stay here tonight. Each one will be watched by two RainWings, and they cannot live in the village until they are trusted.

background.note: The RainWings' home high in the trees of the rainforest, with treehouses, nets and bridges.

paragraphs.context: Sunny glanced around at the NightWings.
paragraphs.simple: The NightWings look sad and shaken. They have just watched the volcano bury their home.

paragraphs.context: “He’s the one who did all the venom experiments on us,” said the other.
paragraphs.simple: The NightWing is Mastermind, Starflight's father. He did experiments on RainWings to learn about their venom.

background.note: Mastermind is a NightWing scientist who does experiments. He is Starflight's father.
Poison made by an animal. RainWings can shoot venom from their fangs that melts whatever it hits; SandWings have poison in the barb on their tail.

paragraphs.context: The NightWings had been kidnapping RainWings for the last year, imprisoning them
paragraphs.simple: For a year the NightWings took RainWings away and kept them as prisoners for experiments. They planned to take the rainforest for themselves.

paragraphs.context: Sunny had seen the lava-riddled wasteland of an island where the NightWings lived.
paragraphs.mainIdea: Sunny liked the plan at first.
paragraphs.simple: Starflight let the NightWings come to the rainforest if they promised to obey Glory. Sunny liked this idea at first.

background.note: Glory is a RainWing, one of the five dragonets of the prophecy. She can change the colour of her scales and shoot venom.

paragraphs.context: But looking at the muttering dragons around her — the NightWings who didn’t
paragraphs.simple: Now Sunny is not sure. Maybe the NightWings cannot be forgiven.

paragraphs.context: If they could lie about something as huge and important as the
paragraphs.simple: If the NightWings lied about the prophecy, Sunny wonders what else they would lie about.

paragraphs.context: “I’m sorry,” Mastermind croaked weakly. “It was … I was just … for science
paragraphs.simple: Mastermind says sorry in a weak voice and says he did it for science.

paragraphs.context: Fatespeaker shot out of the hole and a moment later, Tsunami hurtled after her.
paragraphs.simple: Fatespeaker and Tsunami rush out of the tunnel and tell everyone to get down.

background.note: Fatespeaker is a cheerful young NightWing. She believes she can see the future.

paragraphs.context: The NightWings by the tunnel all threw themselves to the ground.
paragraphs.simple: A blast of hot air comes out of the tunnel. The volcano is close behind.

paragraphs.context: It was Clay, with his wings shielding Starflight.
paragraphs.simple: Clay comes out holding Starflight. Starflight has bad burns and is holding his eyes. He falls to the ground.

paragraphs.context: But suddenly talons wrapped around her snout and shoulders, and she was
paragraphs.simple: Suddenly someone grabs Sunny from behind and pulls her into the trees.

paragraphs.context: “Quick, while they’re all distracted,” she heard a voice hiss.
paragraphs.simple: A NightWing is pulling Sunny into the forest while everyone else is busy.

paragraphs.context: Wet leaves squelched and slithered under their talons.
paragraphs.simple: Sunny thinks there are three NightWings, sneaking away while nobody is looking.

paragraphs.context: “Here,” one of the dragons said after a while, and they all stopped.
paragraphs.simple: The NightWings stop. They are now far from the crowd, and the rain is very heavy.

paragraphs.context: “Me neither,” said one of the others, a female who was little
paragraphs.simple: One of the NightWings is a thin young female, about nine years old, with a fierce look.

paragraphs.context: “Plus they’ll probably kill me,” said the big dragon.
paragraphs.simple: The big NightWing helped Mastermind lock up the RainWings, so he is afraid they will kill him.

paragraphs.context: “Where are we supposed to go?”
paragraphs.simple: The third NightWing wants to live in the rainforest, but he does not want RainWings telling him what to do.

paragraphs.context: The NightWing dragonet lashed her tail and narrowed her eyes at Sunny.
paragraphs.simple: The young female wants to keep Sunny as a prisoner and trade her, so that a NightWing can become queen of the rainforest.

paragraphs.context: “Like who?” said the other male. He spat a small flame at
paragraphs.simple: The other male says there is nobody to be the next NightWing queen.

background.note: Princess Greatness is a NightWing princess.
Queen Battlewinner was the queen of the NightWings. She died when the volcano erupted.

paragraphs.context: “I’ll take it,” said the dragonet.
paragraphs.simple: The young female says she will be queen.

paragraphs.context: “Well, I have bad news,” Sunny spoke up.
paragraphs.simple: Sunny says that nobody will give anything for her. She feels terrible saying it, because without the prophecy she may really be just a strange little dragon.

paragraphs.context: “That would be annoying,” said the big one.
paragraphs.simple: The big NightWing calls the young female Fierceteeth.

background.note: Fierceteeth is Starflight's sister, a proud young NightWing.

paragraphs.context: Fierceteeth! Sunny remembered what Starflight had told them about the dragonets in
paragraphs.simple: Sunny remembers that Fierceteeth is Starflight's half sister.

paragraphs.context: That might actually be true, Sunny thought with alarm.
paragraphs.simple: A few hours ago Starflight told Sunny that he had always loved her.

paragraphs.context: She still didn’t know how she felt about that.
paragraphs.simple: Sunny does not know how she feels about this. Starflight is her clever, worried friend, and she never thought of him in that way.

paragraphs.context: It was still hard for her to believe that he meant it.
paragraphs.simple: Sunny always thought that nobody, not even Starflight, took her seriously.

paragraphs.context: “Didn’t you see Starflight’s injuries?” she said. “He’s too wounded to have
paragraphs.simple: Sunny says that Starflight is too hurt to help them and Glory does not care about her.

paragraphs.context: “Strongwings won’t let them do that,” Fierceteeth said, stepping closer to the burly dragon.
paragraphs.simple: Fierceteeth says the big dragon, Strongwings, will protect them.

background.note: Strongwings is a NightWing.

paragraphs.context: They’re a couple, Sunny realized. A really strange couple. Strongwings was nearly
paragraphs.simple: Sunny sees that Strongwings and Fierceteeth are a couple. He is huge, but he waits for her to tell him what to do.

paragraphs.context: “I know how we could find out,” said the other male.
paragraphs.simple: The other male takes out a flat, shiny black thing. The rain does not touch it.

paragraphs.context: “The Obsidian Mirror,” said Strongwings with a hiss of admiration.
paragraphs.simple: It is the Obsidian Mirror, an old NightWing treasure. The male is called Preyhunter.

background.note: An old NightWing treasure made of black glass with animus magic. When a dragon says a name and breathes smoke on it, it shows that dragon.
Preyhunter is a NightWing.

paragraphs.context: “She never used it anyway,” snorted Preyhunter.
paragraphs.mainIdea: The queen did not use it.
paragraphs.simple: Preyhunter says Greatness never used the mirror, because she did not trust animus magic.

background.note: An animus is a rare dragon who can put magic into things or make magic happen with a spell. 'Animus-touched' means an object has this kind of magic in it.

paragraphs.context: “It doesn’t work as well as it used to,” Strongwings said.
paragraphs.simple: Strongwings says the mirror does not work as well as before. NightWings think a dragon called Stonemover did something to it.

background.note: Stonemover is a NightWing who went away from his tribe long ago.

paragraphs.context: “A really old animus-touched piece of treasure,” Strongwings explained.
paragraphs.simple: The mirror is very old and has animus magic. The NightWings saved it when the volcano buried their treasure room.

paragraphs.context: He tilted the mirror so it caught the light of the two
paragraphs.simple: Two moons shine through the clouds, and the third is very thin. The rain is lighter now.

background.note: The dragon world has three moons.

paragraphs.context: “Glory,” whispered the dragon holding the Obsidian Mirror.
paragraphs.simple: Preyhunter says "Glory" and breathes smoke on the mirror. A curl of white and purple smoke comes up from the glass.

paragraphs.context: “Mangrove!” the tendril barked abruptly in Glory’s voice. “Make sure none of
paragraphs.simple: The smoke speaks with Glory's voice. They can hear Glory giving orders right now.

background.note: Mangrove is a RainWing who helps Queen Glory.
Jambu is a friendly RainWing who helps the dragonets in the rainforest.

paragraphs.context: Yes, I can see how that would be a useful trick, Sunny thought bitterly.
paragraphs.simple: Sunny thinks the NightWings used this mirror to make other dragons believe they can read minds.

background.note: The power to hear what other dragons are thinking. A dragon who can do this is a 'mind reader'.

paragraphs.context: “You bet, no problem, Your Majesty,” it said.
paragraphs.simple: Jambu says he can only count to about twenty.

paragraphs.context: “Jambu, there are at least two hundred NightWings here,” Glory snapped.
paragraphs.simple: Glory says there are at least two hundred NightWings.

paragraphs.context: “I’ll do it.” A darker coil of smoke appeared, right next to
paragraphs.simple: Deathbringer offers to count. He is the assassin who was sent to kill Glory but helped her instead.

background.note: Deathbringer is a NightWing assassin: his job is to kill dragons when he is told to.

paragraphs.context: “I knew it,” snarled Preyhunter, curling his claws around the mirror.
paragraphs.simple: Preyhunter is angry. He says Deathbringer is a traitor.

background.note: Vengeance is a NightWing who was hurt by RainWing venom.

paragraphs.context: “I think so.” A new spiral of mud-colored smoke wound its
paragraphs.simple: Clay says Starflight is badly burned. They will use darts to keep him asleep while he heals.

paragraphs.context: “And his eyes?” Glory asked. “Will they be all right?”
paragraphs.simple: Glory asks if Starflight's eyes will be all right. Clay does not know.

paragraphs.context: “All right, I did a perimeter sweep,” Tsunami’s voice said bossily as
paragraphs.simple: Tsunami has put more RainWing guards around the NightWings and on the tunnels.

paragraphs.context: “That slime lizard Morrowseer,” Tsunami answered.
paragraphs.simple: Tsunami tells Glory that Morrowseer made up the prophecy so the NightWings could take the rainforest.

paragraphs.context: “Yeah,” Clay said. “Isn’t that crazy? I guess that’s why Morrowseer wanted
paragraphs.simple: Clay says Morrowseer wanted them to choose Blister as the next SandWing queen.

background.note: Blister is one of three SandWing sisters who are fighting to be queen. She is clever and cold.

paragraphs.context: “Too late,” Tsunami said. “Since that’s kind of already happened. The volcano
paragraphs.simple: Tsunami says the volcano already killed Morrowseer.

paragraphs.context: “Are you serious?” Glory demanded, talking over her. “The whole thing was
paragraphs.simple: Glory cannot believe it. They were kept in a cave all their lives, and the SkyWing in the prophecy, who everyone wanted instead of her, was never real.

background.note: Words from the Dragonet Prophecy. The prophecy says the dragonets will come "on wings of fire".

paragraphs.context: “At least we don’t have to worry about it anymore,” Tsunami pointed out.
paragraphs.simple: Tsunami is glad. Without the prophecy they can do what they want, and the Talons of Peace cannot tell them what to do.

background.note: A secret group of dragons from different tribes who want to end the war. They raised the dragonets of the prophecy.

paragraphs.context: “Oh, Sunny will be fine,” said Tsunami.
paragraphs.simple: Tsunami thinks Sunny will be happy again soon and forget about the prophecy.

paragraphs.context: “Well, I can think of lots of ways to keep her busy,” Glory said.
paragraphs.simple: Glory says she can keep Sunny busy. She is still very angry about the lie.

paragraphs.context: Sunny glared at the Obsidian Mirror.
paragraphs.mainIdea: What her friends think of her.
paragraphs.simple: Sunny hates this: her friends think that because she is cheerful, she does not care about important things.

paragraphs.context: I’m not either, Sunny thought. Not that they should. But … what would
paragraphs.simple: Sunny wonders if her friends would do anything to get her back.

paragraphs.context: She knew that was exactly the kind of thing her friends would
paragraphs.simple: Sunny knows her friends would laugh at this idea. But if she is the only one who still believes, she must do something.

paragraphs.context: The NightWing holding the mirror tilted the glass so the smoke tendrils
paragraphs.simple: Preyhunter breathes fire on the mirror and the smoke disappears.

paragraphs.context: Uh-oh. Sunny was not about to be handed over to one
paragraphs.simple: Sunny does not want to be a prisoner again. She looks for a gap in the trees.

paragraphs.context: “Start with Blister,” Strongwings said, his dark eyes glinting in the moonlight.
paragraphs.simple: Strongwings says Blister pays well for information.

paragraphs.context: What does she pay them with?
paragraphs.simple: Sunny wonders how Blister pays. The SandWing treasure was stolen when Queen Oasis was killed, and Burn holds the stronghold.

background.note: Queen Oasis was the SandWing queen before the war. After she died, her three daughters fought over her throne.
Burn is one of three SandWing sisters who are fighting to be queen. She is huge and violent.

paragraphs.context: Queen Scarlet had been planning to hand Sunny over to Burn for
paragraphs.mainIdea: Scarlet wanted to give her to Burn.
paragraphs.simple: Queen Scarlet once planned to give Sunny to Burn for this collection.

background.note: Queen Scarlet was the cruel queen of the SkyWings until she lost her throne. She liked to watch prisoners fight in her arena.

paragraphs.context: “Who has the strongest army?” Fierceteeth asked. “Burn, right? And it would
paragraphs.simple: Fierceteeth says Burn has the biggest army and they should fly to her.

paragraphs.context: Fierceteeth’s howl of pain sent raindrops flying off the leaves around them
paragraphs.simple: Sunny bites Fierceteeth's tail. Strongwings throws Sunny off.

paragraphs.context: “Don’t let her get away!” Fierceteeth shrieked. “Strongwings! Catch her! Kill her
paragraphs.simple: Fierceteeth screams at Strongwings to catch Sunny or kill her.

paragraphs.context: Dangling wet vines smacked against Sunny’s snout as she flew up into the treetops.
paragraphs.simple: Sunny flies up into the trees. She is small enough to fly through narrow gaps.

paragraphs.context: One of her wings hit a branch as she flew past and
paragraphs.simple: Sunny frightens some monkeys. The NightWings breathe fire at a monkey because they think it is her.

paragraphs.context: They won’t be foolish enough to follow me all the way back
paragraphs.simple: Sunny understands that the NightWings will not follow her back to the others.

paragraphs.context: She curled into a ball and threw herself into one of the
paragraphs.simple: Sunny hides in a tree with big leaves and holds very still.

paragraphs.context: “We still have useful information for the next SandWing queen,” said Preyhunter.
paragraphs.simple: Preyhunter says they can still sell information: they know where the dragonets are.

paragraphs.context: Sunny was used to the way her friends talked over her all the time.
paragraphs.simple: Sunny's friends always talk over her. They do not expect her to have good ideas, and they did not even tell her their plan to escape.

paragraphs.context: Like stopping the NightWings. I could follow them right now. I might
paragraphs.simple: Sunny decides she could follow the NightWings herself and stop them.

paragraphs.context: She thought guiltily of Starflight and what he would think when he
paragraphs.simple: Sunny feels bad that she will not be there when Starflight wakes up.

paragraphs.context: Then she thought of what her friends had said about her in
paragraphs.simple: Sunny thinks of what her friends said about her and of all the dragons waiting for the dragonets of destiny.

background.note: The five dragonets of the prophecy: Clay, Tsunami, Glory, Starflight and Sunny. 'Destiny' means what is sure to happen in the future.

paragraphs.context: It was easier to follow the NightWings than Sunny would have expected.
paragraphs.simple: The NightWings are easy to follow: Sunny can see their silver scales, and they are noisy.

paragraphs.context: The sun was rising behind them when they reached the far edge
paragraphs.simple: In the morning they reach the end of the rainforest, near MudWing land.

background.note: Big, strong brown dragons who live in the swamps of the Mud Kingdom. They can hold their breath for up to an hour and hide in mud.

paragraphs.context: The Claws of the Clouds mountains stood out sharply up ahead in
paragraphs.simple: Ahead are the Claws of the Clouds mountains.

background.note: A long line of high, sharp mountains in Pyrrhia, where the Sky Kingdom is.
Red and orange dragons with huge wings who live in the mountains of the Sky Kingdom. They are strong fighters and fast fliers.

paragraphs.context: But there was one exception: Jade Mountain.
paragraphs.simple: One mountain is much taller than the others: Jade Mountain.

background.note: A tall mountain in the middle of Pyrrhia with many caves inside it.

paragraphs.context: The tallest mountain on the continent was easy to spot, and not
paragraphs.simple: Jade Mountain is the tallest mountain in Pyrrhia. Its top looks like two fangs, or the head of a snake.

paragraphs.context: Sunny had been worrying all night about how she would hide from
paragraphs.simple: Sunny worries about hiding in the daylight, because her golden scales shine in the sun. She wishes she had a special power.

paragraphs.context: Sunny kept her distance, choosing the tallest tree she could find and
paragraphs.simple: Sunny hides in a tall tree and listens. The NightWings plan to sleep all day and fly again in the evening.

paragraphs.context: They’ve been breathing volcanic ash and living on dying, rotting scraps, probably

sentences.context: Oasis had had a feeling from the moment Blister hatched: this was the daughter who was going to kill her.

sentences.grammar: The first "had" puts this in the past, and the second "had" means she felt it. The colon (:) then tells you what the feeling was. "Was going to" looks ahead from that past time.

sentences.context: Of course a dragon hero with an epic noble quest would be a little different from everyone else.

sentences.grammar: "Would be" here means "it makes sense that it is". The subject is long: "a dragon hero" + "with ..." telling what kind of hero. "Different from" is the usual pattern.

sentences.context: She’d been saying things like that her whole life, but she’d never felt awful about it until today.

sentences.grammar: "She'd been saying" means she said it again and again up to that time. "Never ... until today" means today was the first time.

sentences.context: Which wasn’t fair — she had good ideas! — but her friends never expected her to have anything useful to say.

sentences.grammar: "Which" starts the sentence and points back to the sentence before. The words between the dashes are an extra thought. "Expect someone to do something" = think they will do it.
